title: Who to ask in one district (finding kind `contacts`; merges into the contacts collection)
description: Public record only: every item carries the URL of the district page it was read from. Nothing is sent by the task that produces this; a person reads it first.

name.description: District name as it appears in the record

as_of.description: The day the pages were read

name.description: Current superintendent, as the district's own page names them

email.description: The office email the district publishes for the superintendent's office; null when it publishes only a web form or a phone number

contact_form.description: The web form, when that is what the district publishes instead of an address

source.description: The district page this was read from

role.description: President, Vice President, District 3, Member, and the like, as the board page says it

email.description: Only when the district publishes a board address for the member; never a personal mailbox

date.description: The next regular meeting after as_of; null when no schedule is posted

public_comment.description: How the public signs up to speak, when the page says

source.description: The schedule or agenda page the date was read from

name.description: The neighboring district that already moved to a ban; the unit names the one the game computed

source.description: Its policy or the record page, when you checked it

notes.description: Anything the reviewer needs: a superintendent change, a page that is out of date, what could not be found
